_README: Official Internlytic internship tracks. Skill requirements and prerequisites are initial matching configurations and should be confirmed with Internlytic before treating the catalogue as fully verified.

programs.name: Artificial Intelligence
programs.description: Build and deploy real AI/ML models under the guidance of working engineers who ship production systems.
prerequisites: Interest in artificial intelligence and machine learning

programs.name: Full Stack Web Development
programs.description: Ship production-grade web applications end-to-end, from React interfaces to Node.js APIs and databases.

programs.name: UI/UX Design
programs.description: Design polished, user-centered interfaces backed by real research, wireframing and usability testing.
prerequisites: Interest in user interface and user experience design

programs.name: Front End Development
programs.description: Craft fast, responsive interfaces with React under mentors who ship pixel-perfect, production-ready UI every day.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Interest in building interactive web interfaces

programs.name: Machine Learning
programs.description: Train, evaluate and deploy real ML models, from data preparation to production, guided by experienced mentors.
prerequisites: Interest in mathematics, statistics and machine learning

programs.name: Prompt Engineering
programs.description: Master the craft of designing, testing and refining prompts to get reliable, production-grade results from real AI systems.
prerequisites: Interest in artificial intelligence and language models
